scope: Agere answer pipeline: question parse -> routing -> population -> definitions -> SQL generation -> verification -> execution -> answer rendering -> follow-ups -> learning reuse

scales.severity: 1 no effect ... 2 cosmetic ... 4-5 no answer or a usable answer needing rework ... 7-8 wrong number delivered with confidence ... 9 wrong number carrying a verified receipt or a fabricated answer ... 10 harm without warning
scales.occurrence: Derived from evidence: adjudicated engine errors (or mechanical failures, or control replay hits) per answerable blind question. >=10%:10, >=5%:9, >=2%:8, >=1%:7, >=0.5%:6, >=0.2%:5, >=0.1%:4, observed but rarer:3, not observed in n opportunities:2. Modes with no measurable evidence use occurrence_judgment.
scales.detection: 1 certain detection before the user sees it ... 3 automated check flags it on the answer ... 5 caught only by a benchmark or reviewer ... 7 rarely caught ... 9-10 undetectable without a reference answer
scales.rpn: severity x occurrence x detection; detection_before = before the answer-level controls in clinical_core/agere/clinical/answer_checks.py

modes.failure_mode: Correlated two-model error passes the agreement check
modes.effect: Wrong answer carries a "verified" receipt
modes.cause: Both models share the same misreading of the data; agreement predicted correctness ~60% vs ~50% when measured on blind L/M
modes.note: Every adjudicated hosted-route engine error passed lint, sanity and agreement; the added answer checks are independent of the models but cover only part of the mode.

modes.failure_mode: Wrong answer captured as a verified training pair
modes.effect: Errors that passed verification become examples for future questions and bottled-model training
modes.cause: Learning captures every verified answer; verification misses correlated errors (FM-13)
controls_existing: only verified or user-confirmed answers are captured

modes.failure_mode: Wrong denominator or population restriction (age band, roster, attribution, organisation scope)
modes.effect: Rate or count over the wrong population; looks plausible, so it is rarely questioned
modes.cause: Measure denominators (HEDIS age bands, attribution, practice organisations) not encoded for the SQL writer
controls_existing: definitions registry cites the governing standard (local and graph routes)

modes.failure_mode: Concept or value set too narrow or too broad (drug class, visit types, lab concept)
modes.effect: Numerator misses or over-includes cases
modes.cause: Free-text LIKE filters; concept library gaps for the question's vocabulary
controls_existing: concept library + drug_classes (verify.lint rejects unknown classes and LIKE on drug_class)

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: concept|drug.?class|visit type|therapeutic|narrow|sweeps in|statin records|definition|instead of|missed the|qualify|inflates the numerator

modes.failure_mode: Snapshot/version duplicates counted or summed (encounters, claims, appointments, accounts)
modes.effect: Inflated counts and money totals
modes.cause: Versioned streams arrive as successive snapshots; raw record table holds every version
controls_existing: VERSIONED_STREAMS hints in the SQL prompt

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: without distinct|rather than distinct|not distinct|de-?duplicat|duplicate|versions? (?:are|is) counted|encounter versions|adjudication versions|versioned|snapshot|current[- ]state|current/as-of

modes.failure_mode: Explicit qualifier or requested part silently dropped (in-person, first-generation, same draw time, "how many and how much")
modes.effect: A confident answer to a broader or different question; the user cannot see the constraint was ignored
modes.cause: Hosted SQL writer ignores a qualifier the local compiler would have refused to drop; no word-coverage check on the SQL route

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: asks specifically|specifically for|explicitly asked|question specifies|dropped the|ignoring the user

modes.failure_mode: Wrong clock or date field (arrival vs event, submission vs adjudication)
modes.effect: Timing metrics measure the data feed instead of the business event
modes.cause: Several clocks per record (event, recorded, available, first_available); semantic layer exposes some derived dates only
controls_existing: nl2sql rules on event_date vs available_date

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: first_available_date|availability date|arriv|date field|\bclock\b|rather than from the earliest|event_date for each

modes.failure_mode: Undated or null records mishandled (undated rows picked as latest, undated baseline joins drop everyone)
modes.effect: Wrong "latest" values or empty results
modes.cause: 16,543 undated labs; baselines recorded once without a date

modes.failure_mode: Wrong entity counted (patients vs rows vs encounters)
modes.effect: Answer counts something else entirely (e.g. roster size)
modes.cause: Question names records but the query counts patients, or the reverse
controls_existing: nl2sql rules: patients = count(DISTINCT patient_id), records = count(*)

modes.failure_mode: Answers a question the data cannot support
modes.effect: A fabricated-looking number for something not in the data (race, death, CPT)
modes.cause: Unsupported prerequisites not recognised

modes.failure_mode: Defensible alternative definition used without the user seeing it
modes.effect: A reasonable but different number; the reader assumes their own definition
modes.cause: Ambiguous question; definition stated only when a governed definition was used

modes.failure_mode: Source data defects distort results (feed gaps, partial feeds, generator defects)
modes.effect: Trends and rates reflect data arrival, not care
modes.cause: Synthetic generator defects D1-D22 (SYNTHETIC_DATA_ISSUES.md)
controls_existing: LOS left empty when discharge unknown
modes.note: Occurrence judged from the 22 logged generator defects, not from benchmark failures.

modes.failure_mode: Wrong answer shape (count vs list vs rate vs table)
modes.effect: Answer is not usable as asked (a count when a rate or list was requested)
modes.cause: Shape inferred from wording; SQL writer returns its own shape

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: instead of a (?:rate|list|count|table|percentage)|returned a count of

modes.failure_mode: Nonexistent field, stream or join (hallucinated schema)
modes.effect: NULL-filled joins give zero or empty results presented as findings
modes.cause: json_extract on a missing field silently returns NULL
controls_existing: verify.lint: streams, fields, values and concepts must exist in the received data

modes.failure_mode: Unit mismatch (cents vs dollars, days vs hours, fraction vs percent)
modes.effect: Off by 100x or 24x; or a hours figure that is really whole days
modes.cause: Money stored in cents; durations stored as day counts
controls_existing: verify.sanity cents-vs-dollars and fraction-vs-percent checks (SQL route, scalar results)

modes.failure_mode: Partial current period in a time series (latest month/quarter/year only partly observed)
modes.effect: An apparent drop in the latest period that is only missing days
modes.cause: Snapshot cutoff falls mid-period; series answers report the latest period like any other
controls_existing: early_signal and monitor exclude the partial month (engine routes only)

modes.failure_mode: The benchmark reference itself is wrong, so a correct engine answer is counted as a defect (or a wrong one as correct)
modes.effect: Misdirected fixes; scorecard error rate wrong
modes.cause: Reference SQL encodes a different definition than the question
modes.note: bench/mutation_audit.py searches distinguishing databases for reference vs candidate SQL and every errata correction; evidence attached by adjudicate.py. test_mutation_audit
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: False "data is missing" refusal on an answerable question
modes.effect: No answer where one was possible; user goes elsewhere
modes.cause: MissingData raised by the hosted SQL writer when stream retrieval misses the right stream
controls_existing: missing-data claim re-checked against the full data dictionary before refusing (2026-10-13)

evidence_rule.adjudicated_pattern: refus|claim(?:ed|ing)? (?:the )?(?:\w+ )*(?:missing|unavailable)|wrongly claimed|returned no (?:result|answer|rate)|no answer|null answer|wrongly called

modes.failure_mode: Stale learned plan reused after the data or semantic layer changed
modes.effect: Yesterday's verified plan answers today's data with yesterday's logic
modes.cause: Learned plans keyed on question text
controls_existing: learning.lookup requires context = source digest + semantic_layer.VERSION
modes.note: Residual: a semantic-layer change that does not bump VERSION keeps old plans eligible.

modes.failure_mode: Exact-local recognizer answers a narrower or broader population than asked (e.g. all AFib vs CHA2DS2-VASc >= 2)
modes.effect: Confident answer to a different clinical question
modes.cause: Keyword recognizers match a task family but not its population or threshold
modes.note: clinical_tasks.fits: the question must state the task population and thresholds; other numbers or a strict ">" decline to the next tier. test_clinical_tasks.RecognizerTests
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: A correct empty answer is rejected by the shape / zero-result checks and a worse proposer answers
modes.effect: A wrong "not answerable" or substitute answer replaces the right empty set
modes.cause: Engine tables with zero rows did not satisfy a patient_set shape check
modes.note: Observed 2026-10-22 on CT-09 (no MRA patient with K >= 5.5): exact_local_plan rejected, local_compiler answered "not answerable". clinical_tasks.answer returns the requested shape. test_clinical_tasks.EngineTests.test_empty_answer_keeps_requested_shape
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Execution error, timeout or no answer
modes.effect: User gets an error instead of an answer
modes.cause: Service restarts mid-run, provider budget exhaustion, validator exceptions
controls_existing: errors surface as explicit failures, never as answers

modes.failure_mode: System One label "unknown", an error or an outage silently becomes a documented reason (or "none documented")
modes.effect: A gap reason the chart does not support, or a false all-clear
modes.cause: Typed-judgment output treated as definite without its abstention
controls_existing: atomic_questions keeps unknown and cites evidence
modes.note: clinical_tasks.review fills a reason only from a non-unknown System One label with its cited passage; counts reviewed / open / capped on the receipt. test_clinical_tasks.ReviewTests
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Production defect rate drifts (refusals, internal errors, user-reported wrong answers) with nobody noticing
modes.effect: Silent loss of answer quality between benchmark runs
modes.cause: Answer log was only read for cost
modes.note: quality_scorecard.production: DPMO, sigma, Wilson interval and a Laney p-chart per day from answers.sqlite3 + corrections, served at /api/scorecard. test_quality_gates.ProductionTests
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Wrong time window or as-of cutoff
modes.effect: Answer covers the wrong period
modes.cause: Relative periods ("past 12 months", "2028") translated by the model
modes.occurrence_basis: measured: not observed in the recorded opportunities

modes.failure_mode: Follow-up rewrite drops or changes a slot
modes.effect: The follow-up answers a different question than the conversation implies
modes.cause: Model rewrite of "now by practice" / "only Medicare" into a standalone question
controls_existing: economical_planner.rewrite_dropped refuses rewrites that lose recognised elements
resolved question shown on the card
modes.note: One silent drop (medication-plus-visit) found and fixed by the follow-up builder on 2026-10-13; no benchmark measures follow-ups yet.

modes.failure_mode: A sequence window in weeks / months / years compiles to the wrong day bound, or a "first" anchor matches every event
modes.effect: Wrong temporal cohort delivered with a correct-looking plan
modes.cause: Unit conversion and anchor ranking were implicit
modes.note: request_plan.sequence validates window n x unit against the day bounds and discloses it in notes; rank first/last joins the per-patient MIN/MAX. test_temporal_composition
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Right numbers, wrong presentation (rounding, column names, split rows, partial flag on a right value)
modes.effect: Strict contract fails although the substance is right
modes.cause: Presentation precision and naming differ from the requester's

modes.failure_mode: Invalid answer contract or truncated result
modes.effect: Answer cannot be read by the client; or a table silently cut
modes.cause: Contract assembly bug; row limits

modes.failure_mode: Claude outage: the System One fallback returns a candidate a check judged to answer a different question
modes.effect: A substituted answer marked only partial
modes.cause: Fallback pool not filtered by the reason for rejection
controls_existing: Cascade.system_one_fallback skips candidates with a System One different-question rejection
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Question routed to the wrong engine or rung
modes.effect: Right data, wrong method (e.g. a literal count sent to an analytic engine or vice versa)
modes.cause: Operator router is a small-model classification; compiler accepts a near-miss reading
modes.occurrence_basis: measured: not observed in the recorded opportunities

modes.failure_mode: A paid System One / Jev / Perplexity call never reaches the cascade usage or receipt
modes.effect: Hidden spend; token economics understated
modes.cause: A component spends inside an engine without returning its calls
modes.note: clinical_tasks.review adds new_paid_api_calls to its report; analysis_graph adds an engine review's calls to paid_calls. test_clinical_tasks.ReviewTests.test_review_charges_calls; test_system_one_gate.test_gate_charges_the_cascade
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Sealed truth rows leak into Agere (printed, saved or trained on)
modes.effect: The sealed evaluation stops being an honest measure
modes.cause: Scorer output or predictions carried row-level content
modes.note: tools/quality/sealed_gate.aggregates drops ids, row lists and long text before printing or saving. test_quality_gates.SealedGateTests
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: System One routing drops or permanently skips a cascade tier
modes.effect: A question a later tier could answer is refused
modes.cause: Router output used as a filter instead of an order
modes.occurrence_basis: judgment (no benchmark measures this mode; 2026-10-22 cascade review)

modes.failure_mode: Cached plan or answer reused across a changed slot or context
modes.effect: A stale answer to a different question
modes.cause: Cache keyed too loosely
controls_existing: exact-question plan cache keyed on question text + code + source digest + snapshot
result cache keyed on plan + code identity
modes.note: No approximate/semantic answer cache exists by design (economical_planner docstring).
